upgrades.ability: While a friendly ship at range 0-2 defends, if the attack is obstructed by an obstacle, you may spend 1 [Energy]. If you do, the defender rolls 1 additional defense die.

upgrades.name: Kaz's Fireball
upgrades.ability: Setup: When you resolve Explosion with Wings, you may search the damage deck and choose a damage card with the Ship trait; you are dealt that card instead. Then, shuffle the damage deck. You can perform actions on damage cards even while ionized.

upgrades.name: Liberator
upgrades.ability: You can dock up to 2 small ships. After a ship deploys from you, it may perform a [Focus] or [Barrel Roll] action.

upgrades.name: Luminous
upgrades.ability: Setup: You are placed in reserve. At the end of setup, you are placed in the play area at range 0-2 of a friendly ship.

upgrades.name: Merchant One
upgrades.ability: Add [Turret], [Team], and [Cargo] slots. Bonus Attack: Perform a [Turret] attack.

upgrades.name: Quantum Storm
upgrades.ability: Add [Team] and [Cargo] slots. After you fully execute a white maneuver, recover 1 [Energy].

upgrades.name: Requiem
upgrades.ability: After a ship deploys from you, it may acquire a lock on one ship you are locking, ignoring range restrictions.

upgrades.name: Suppressor
upgrades.ability: Add [Sensor] slot. After you coordinate a friendly ship, you may spend 1 [Energy] to jam an enemy ship at range 0-2 of that ship, ignoring range restrictions.

upgrades.name: Tantive IV
upgrades.ability: Add 2 [Crew] slots. While you defend, if the attacker is in your [Rear Arc], you may roll 1 additional defense die.

upgrades.name: Thunderstrike
upgrades.ability: Add [Gunner] slot. While you perform a bonus attack, if you have not attacked the defender this round, you may reroll 1 attack die.

upgrades.name: Vector
upgrades.ability: Add [Crew] and [Cargo] slots. After a ship deploys from you, it may perform a [Evade] or [Boost] action.

upgrades.name: Slave I
upgrades.ability: While you perform a [Front Arc] attack, if you are in the defender's [Full Rear Arc], you may change 1 [Hit] result to a [Critical Hit] result. Add [Gunner] slot.

upgrades.name: B6 Blade Wing Prototype
upgrades.ability: Add [Gunner] slot.

upgrades.name: Nautolan's Revenge
upgrades.ability: Before you engage, you may spend up to 2 calculate tokens. If you do, recover that many [Energy].

upgrades.name: Grappler
upgrades.ability: While you perform a Drill Beak attack at range 1, if the defender is tractored, treat it as being range 0 instead.

upgrades.name: Neimoidian Grasp
upgrades.ability: After you perform an attack, you may perform a red [Evade] action. While you defend, if you are evading, you may roll 1 additional defense die.

upgrades.name: Trident
upgrades.ability: After you overlap a ship or a ship overlaps you, if it is not tractored, you may spend 1 [Energy]. If you do, it gains 3 tractor tokens.

upgrades.name: Nightbrother
upgrades.ability: After you reveal a non-blue maneuver, if you are stressed, you may spend 2 [Charge] to gain 1 focus or evade token. Add [Crew] slot.

upgrades.name: Gauntlet
upgrades.ability: During the System Phase, you may spend 1 [Charge] to repair 1 faceup ship damage card. Add [Crew] slot.

upgrades.name: Razor Crest
upgrades.ability: Setup: Place 1 non-limited [Illicit] upgrade facedown under this card. During the System Phase, you may reveal that [Illicit] upgrade and equip it as if it were equipped at Setup (without paying its points cost).

upgrades.name: Xanadu Blood
upgrades.ability: Add [Crew] and [Device] slots.

upgrades.name: Homing Torpedoes
upgrades.ability: Attack ([Lock]): Spend 1 [Charge]. After you declare the defender, the defender may choose to suffer 1 [Critical Hit] damage. If it does, skip the Attack and Defense Dice steps and the attack is treated as hitting.

upgrades.name: Adv. Proton Torpedoes
upgrades.ability: Attack ([Lock]): Spend 1 [Charge]. Change 1 [Hit] result to a [Critical Hit] result.

upgrades.name: Ion Torpedoes
upgrades.ability: Attack ([Lock]): Spend 1 [Charge]. If this attack hits, spend 1 [Hit] or [Critical Hit] result to cause the defender to suffer 1 [Hit] damage. All remaining [Hit]/[Critical Hit] results inflict ion tokens instead of damage.

upgrades.name: Proton Torpedoes
upgrades.ability: Attack ([Lock]): Spend 1 [Charge]. Change 1 [Hit] result to a [Critical Hit] result.

upgrades.name: Plasma Torpedoes
upgrades.ability: Attack ([Lock]): Spend 1 [Charge]. During the Neutralize Results step, [Critical Hit] results are canceled before [Hit] results. After this attack hits, the defender loses 1 shield.

upgrades.name: Tracking Torpedoes
upgrades.ability: During the System Phase, you may spend up to 3 [Charge] to launch that many tracking torpedoes using the [3 [Bank Left]], [4 [Straight]], and [3 [Bank Right]] templates. Each device must use a seperate template. Then each device may acquire a lock on an object you have locked, ignoring range restrictions. This card's [Charge] cannot be recovered.

upgrades.name: Dorsal Turret
upgrades.ability: Attack

upgrades.name: Ion Cannon Turret
upgrades.ability: Attack: If this attack hits, spend 1 [Hit] or [Critical Hit] result to cause the defender to suffer 1 [Hit] damage. All remaining [Hit]/[Critical Hit] results inflict ion tokens instead of damage.
